Microsoft.title: GitHub - nano-muse/nanoMuse: nanoMuse: an open-source personal agent for every device you own. One agent with a name and a look of its own that does things, keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and asks before anything you cannot undo. On Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows / macOS / Linux and in the browser; your phone's screen and your computer as its hands.

Microsoft.summary:
MobileGym , MemGUI-Bench , PhoneHarness , CopilotKit/OpenMuse , Open-AutoGLM , ClawGUI : the phone operator, the traces and the product ideas. nanoMuse is an independent community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta Platforms, Inc.; Muse is their trademark.
One agent with a name and a look of its own, in the style of Meta's Muse : it does things instead of answering questions, keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and stops to ask before anything you could not undo. nano means the whole set, small enough to run and deploy yourself: the phone app, the desktop app, the web console and the relay that joins them are all in this repository, under GPL-3.0-or-later.
Open an issue or send a pull request ; either one helps nanoMuse get better. 2026-10-21 ⭐ 2,000 stars on GitHub and first on GitHub Trending's Swift list ( Trendshift : third on October 20, first on October 21), twenty-six days after the first release.

Microsoft.titleEn: Designing Azure silicon on Azure silicon: EDA workloads on Cobalt 200 | Microsoft Azure Blog
Microsoft.titleKo: Azure 실리콘에서 Azure 실리콘 설계 · Cobalt 200의 EDA 워크로드 | 마이크로소프트 애저 블로그
Microsoft.summary:
Cobalt 200 was optimized for EDA workloads through increased cache size and improved memory bandwidth per core.
The shift to cloud-based EDA on Microsoft Azure offered a new level of flexibility, scale, and reliability on compute-intensive silicon design workloads.
Executing Siemens EDA solutions on Microsoft Azure Cobalt 200 provides an efficient, scalable platform for demanding verification and signoff workloads.

Microsoft Azure에서 클라우드 기반 EDA로의 전환은 컴퓨팅 집약적인 실리콘 설계 워크로드에 새로운 수준의 유연성, 확장성 및 안정성을 제공함

Microsoft.title: Stop treating agents as one-off projects and start running them as a continuous discipline | Microsoft Azure Blog
Microsoft.titleEn: Stop treating agents as one-off projects and start running them as a continuous discipline | Microsoft Azure Blog
Microsoft.titleKo: 에이전트를 일회성 프로젝트로 취급하지 말고 지속적인 분야로 실행하기 시작 | 마이크로소프트 애저 블로그
Microsoft.summary:
Stop treating agents as one-off projects and start running them as a continuous discipline Transformation begins at the line between an experiment that works and a capability the business depends on.
A new IDC InfoBrief, sponsored by Microsoft, Scaling AI Without Scaling Costs *, on how organizations are funding and governing AI, shows both the urgency of that shift and the friction holding it back.
Only 17% of organizations build models to project how costs scale in production—even as about 78% prioritize cost efficiency when selecting a model. 86% expect financial results within six to 24 months—roughly one budget cycle to show something real.
summaryLinesEn: Stop treating agents as one-off projects and start running them as a continuous discipline Transformation begins at the line between an experiment that works and a capability the business depends on.

A new IDC InfoBrief, sponsored by Microsoft, Scaling AI Without Scaling Costs *, on how organizations are funding and governing AI, shows both the urgency of that shift and the friction holding it back.

Only 17% of organizations build models to project how costs scale in production—even as about 78% prioritize cost efficiency when selecting a model. 86% expect financial results within six to 24 months—roughly one budget cycle to show something real.
summaryLinesKo: 에이전트를 일회성 프로젝트로 취급하지 말고 지속적인 원칙으로 실행하기 시작하십시오 · 전환은 효과적인 실험과 비즈니스가 의존하는 기능 사이의 경계에서 시작됨
Microsoft가 후원하는 새로운 IDC InfoBrief, 확장 비용 없이 AI 확장*은 조직이 AI에 자금을 지원하고 관리하는 방법에 대해 이러한 변화의 긴급성과 이를 방해하는 마찰을 모두 보여줌
약 78%가 모델을 선택할 때 비용 효율성을 우선시하는 반면, 조직 중 17%만이 생산 시 비용 규모를 예측하기 위해 모델을 구축함 · 86%는 6~24개월 이내에 재무 결과를 기대함 · 대략 한 번의 예산 주기로 실제적인 결과가 나올 것으로 예상됨

Microsoft.summary:
Prepare your automation for Scheduled Events : Make sure your automation can process Scheduled Events for Azure Virtual Machines , including events with a NotBefore time up to seven days in the future.
This is the old model Azure has spent years moving away from, one built around mission-critical escalations, supply chain constraints, and manual recovery.
To learn more, watch our companion video to learn how AFPD helps reduce the risk of failures disrupting your critical workloads.

Microsoft.summary:
Already, a Windows malware implant reported in September was built around a panel of up to four LLMs that vote on its next move, and another, reported this week, can fall back to using the victim’s own OpenAI API key.
The target should revoke or rotate all API keys and tokens and change passwords, regardless of exposure; likewise, any funds in a wallet whose seed phrase was stored in plaintext should be moved to a new wallet with a fresh seed, preferably generated on an air-gapped device.
Operating systems need a defensive AI built-in, of course they must be working on this already...

대상은 노출 여부에 관계없이 모든 API 키와 토큰을 취소 또는 교체하고 비밀번호를 변경해야 함 · 마찬가지로, 시드 문구가 일반 텍스트로 저장된 지갑의 모든 자금은 가급적이면 에어갭 장치에서 생성된 신선한 시드가 있는 새 지갑으로 이동해야 함
운영 체제에는 내장형 방어 AI가 필요함 · 물론 이미 이에 대해 작업하고 있어야 함

Microsoft.title: Microsoft’s AI future has fewer jobs
Microsoft.titleEn: Microsoft’s AI future has fewer jobs
Microsoft.summary:
This week’s voluntary exit offer arrived just months after Microsoft laid off 4,800 employees , cuts that impacted its Xbox and commercial sales teams the most.
How Nadella handles that transition will define his legacy as much as the growth and success he’s achieved over the past decade.
“Our total people costs will go down, our cost per head will go up, and my GPU per researcher will go up,” Nadella said on a podcast almost two years ago, responding to a question about AI’s impact on headcount.
summaryLinesEn: This week’s voluntary exit offer arrived just months after Microsoft laid off 4,800 employees , cuts that impacted its Xbox and commercial sales teams the most.
How Nadella handles that transition will define his legacy as much as the growth and success he’s achieved over the past decade.

“Our total people costs will go down, our cost per head will go up, and my GPU per researcher will go up,” Nadella said on a podcast almost two years ago, responding to a question about AI’s impact on headcount.
summaryLinesKo: 이번 주 자발적 퇴직 제안은 Microsoft가 4,800명의 직원을 해고한 지 불과 몇 달 만에 이루어졌으며, 이는 Xbox 및 상업 판매 팀에 가장 큰 영향을 미쳤음
Nadella가 이러한 전환을 처리하는 방법은 그가 지난 10년 동안 달성한 성장과 성공만큼이나 그의 유산을 정의할 것임
Nadella는 거의 2년 전 팟캐스트에서 AI가 인원 수에 미치는 영향에 대한 질문에 답하면서 "총 인력 비용은 줄어들고, 1인당 비용은 올라가고, 연구원당 GPU는 올라갈 것임" · 라고 말함

NVIDIA.title: From Chips to Skills, NVIDIA and Korea Expand Sovereign AI Collaboration
NVIDIA.titleEn: From Chips to Skills, NVIDIA and Korea Expand Sovereign AI Collaboration
NVIDIA.titleKo: 칩부터 기술까지, 엔비디아와 한국, 소버린 AI 협업 확대
NVIDIA.summary:
NVIDIA and Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) are expanding their collaboration across the country’s sovereign AI ecosystem, from AI semiconductors and data center infrastructure to talent, startups, models, agents and security.
The collaboration lays the groundwork for Korean NPU and XPU companies to explore participation in the NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ecosystem, and includes NVIDIA training and certification programs, hackathons and technical seminars to strengthen GPU utilization.
Through Korea’s AI for All initiative, NVIDIA will collaborate with three selected consortia and four leading Korean foundation model builders, using NVIDIA Dynamo software to optimize and scale AI inference.
summaryLinesEn: NVIDIA and Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) are expanding their collaboration across the country’s sovereign AI ecosystem, from AI semiconductors and data center infrastructure to talent, startups, models, agents and security.

The collaboration lays the groundwork for Korean NPU and XPU companies to explore participation in the NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ecosystem, and includes NVIDIA training and certification programs, hackathons and technical seminars to strengthen GPU utilization.

NVIDIA.titleKo: NVIDIA, 과기정통부-NVIDIA AI 스타트업 파트너십 포럼에서 한국 스타트업에 대한 새로운 투자 계획 발표
NVIDIA.summary:
NVIDIA also announced an investment in Korean startup Point2 , with additional investments planned in Motif Technologies , RLWRLD and Upstage.
The planned investments build on NVIDIA’s work with Korea’s startup and venture community, including more than 1,000 Korea-based members of NVIDIA Inception , a program that helps startups grow with access to preferred pricing, technical expertise and opportunities for investor introductions.
Point2 Technology, an AI interconnect company, builds scalable, radio frequency-based interconnects that move data between chips and racks in AI factories, offering an innovative alternative to conventional copper and optical interconnect solutions for AI cluster scale-up, delivering the reach, performance and efficiency needed for next-generation AI infrastructure.
summaryLinesEn: NVIDIA also announced an investment in Korean startup Point2 , with additional investments planned in Motif Technologies , RLWRLD and Upstage.

The planned investments build on NVIDIA’s work with Korea’s startup and venture community, including more than 1,000 Korea-based members of NVIDIA Inception , a program that helps startups grow with access to preferred pricing, technical expertise and opportunities for investor introductions.

summaryLinesKo: NVIDIA는 또한 Motif Technologies, RLWRLD 및 Upstage에 대한 추가 투자 계획과 함께 한국 스타트업 Point2에 대한 투자를 발표함
계획된 투자는 스타트업이 우대 가격, 기술 전문 지식 및 투자자 소개 기회를 이용하여 성장할 수 있도록 돕는 프로그램인 NVIDIA Inception의 한국 기반 회원 1,000명 이상을 포함하여 한국 스타트업 및 벤처 커뮤니티와의 NVIDIA의 협력을 기반으로 함
AI 상호 연결 회사인 Point2 Technology는 AI 공장의 칩과 랙 간에 데이터를 이동하는 확장 가능한 무선 주파수 기반 상호 연결을 구축하여 AI 클러스터 확장을 위한 기존 구리 및 광 상호 연결 솔루션에 대한 혁신적인 대안을 제공하고 차세대 AI 인프라에 필요한 도달 범위, 성능 및 효율성을 제공함

NVIDIA.titleEn: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
NVIDIA.titleKo: NVIDIA 오픈 소스 도구가 연구원들이 차세대 6G 네트워크를 구축하는 데 어떻게 도움이 됩니까
NVIDIA.summary:
At the University of Leeds , researchers developed a system that predicts network demand 10 minutes ahead and uses those forecasts to guide base station sleep decisions.
Over the past year, global developer adoption of NVIDIA AI Aerial and NVIDIA Sionna software has grown 10x, while NVIDIA’s open source 5G/6G tools have surpassed 1 million downloads.
Before powering down, it checks that neighboring active stations can continue serving affected devices and monitors for changes that require capacity to be restored.

지난 한 해 동안 NVIDIA AI Aerial 및 NVIDIA Sionna 소프트웨어의 전 세계 개발자 채택이 10배 증가했으며 NVIDIA의 오픈 소스 5G/6G 도구는 다운로드 수가 100만 건을 넘었음
전원을 끄기 전에 인접한 활성 스테이션이 영향을 받은 장치에 계속 서비스를 제공할 수 있는지 확인하고 용량 복원이 필요한 변경 사항을 모니터링함

NVIDIA.summary:
At 125 tokens per second per user, Vera Rubin NVL72 delivers up to 30x higher throughput per dollar than GB300 NVL72, with HBM capacity per GPU up about 3%.
NVIDIA was first to adopt HBM3e and HBM4 technologies into an accelerated computing stack.
Recent models, including FLUX.2 [klein] from Black Forest Labs , Inkling from Thinking Machines Lab, Beam 1.0 from Reflection , Meta Muse Spark from Meta , Step 5 Preview from StepFun and NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL have been released with NVFP4 checkpoints, demonstrating growing model-builder adoption of 4-bit precision for faster, more memory-efficient inference.

Apple.summary:
SpeakerDiarizer runs NVIDIA's Streaming Sortformer on Core ML alongside an Apple or Parakeet transcriber, on the same timeline: The diarizer tracks up to four speakers, even when they talk over each other.
Apple platforms already have an API for it. macOS 26 and iOS 26 introduced SpeechAnalyzer , Apple's new speech-to-text API.
Like image support in AnyLanguageModel, this goes beyond what Apple's API offers today.

Google DeepMind.title: Don't like Google Health's AI Coach? Here's how to turn it off - Engadget
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Don't like Google Health's AI Coach? Here's how to turn it off - Engadget
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Google Health의 AI 코치가 마음에 들지 않나요 · 끄는 방법은 다음과 같습니다 - Engadget
Google DeepMind.summary:
Select Your data in Google Health then scroll down to Feature privacy controls and select Manage feature privacy controls .
If you don't like Google Health's AI Coach or need a break from its constant advice, the easiest way to get rid of it is to cancel your Google Health Premium subscription, since AI Coach does not come with the free Google Health tier.
Don't worry, because there is a way to keep Google Health Premium but temporarily (or permanently) set aside the Gemini-powered AI Coach in the app settings thanks to an update released in August 2026.

Google DeepMind.summary:
Longer clips with smoother motion and tighter consistency Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generates clips up to 15 seconds long that hold references together better than before.
Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash brings 15-second clips, stronger consistency, and faster, more cost-effective generation.
We have dropped the price 30% from Gemini Omni 1.1 making it available at $0.07 per second for 720p video.

Amazon.titleEn: Extend Claude Code to remote sessions on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with security controls | Amazon Web Services

Amazon.summary:
Amazon Bedrock doesn’t use your content to train models or share it with model providers, and providers can’t access your prompts, completions, or the Amazon Bedrock service logs.
Model calls from remote tasks therefore keep the same security characteristics as Claude Code on your laptop.
Claude Code reviews the result with Claude Opus and can send it back to planning for another attempt, up to three attempts in total.

Amazon.summary:
Today more than 55 percent of users who ask Assist a question return to ask another within 24 hours, according to Taxbit’s internal production analytics.
Founded in 2018, Taxbit helps enterprises such as exchanges, payment services, and brokers calculate gains and losses, collect tax documentation, and file information returns at scale.
In this post, we share how we built Taxbit Assist , the AI assistant now embedded in the Taxbit dashboard, on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore , a platform to build, connect, and optimize agents at scale, with any framework or model.

2018년에 설립된 Taxbit은 거래소, 결제 서비스, 중개인과 같은 기업이 손익을 계산하고, 세금 서류를 수집하고, 대규모로 정보 신고서를 제출할 수 있도록 지원함

Because these primitives compose, the same request can be met several valid ways: A scheduled task with a one-line instruction, leaving the agent to figure out the rest.
Over the past year, as we built Amazon Quick, our agents went from answering questions to taking actions: scheduling meetings, running research, generating reports.
Next in the series: the agentic operating system that builds on these primitives and powers Amazon Quick.

Amazon.title: SageMaker Inference now supports Multi-Instance GPU to maximize GPU utilization for model endpoints | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleEn: SageMaker Inference now supports Multi-Instance GPU to maximize GPU utilization for model endpoints | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleKo: SageMaker Inference는 이제 멀티 인스턴스 GPU를 지원하여 모델 엔드포인트에 대한 GPU 활용도를 극대화합니다 | 아마존 웹 서비스
Amazon.summary:
Use multi-model endpoints – These load and unload models from a shared GPU on demand, which fits sparse, bursty traffic.
Today, Amazon SageMaker Inference supports GPU partitioning, which uses NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) to divide a physical GPU into independent partitions.
Because the split is in hardware rather than software, you get guarantees that other sharing methods can’t give: Predictable latency – Each partition has dedicated memory bandwidth, so one model’s traffic spike doesn’t show up in another model’s p99.

현재 Amazon SageMaker Inference는 NVIDIA 멀티 인스턴스 GPU(MIG)를 사용하여 물리적 GPU를 독립 파티션으로 나누는 GPU 파티셔닝을 지원함

Anthropic.title: Andrej Karpathy built a curated video platform in a weekend using Claude and 20 years of Hacker News
Anthropic.titleEn: Andrej Karpathy built a curated video platform in a weekend using Claude and 20 years of Hacker News
Anthropic.titleKo: Andrej Karpathy는 Claude와 20년간의 Hacker News를 사용하여 주말에 선별된 비디오 플랫폼을 구축함
Anthropic.summary:
Claude filtered 43 million comments from 20 years of Hacker News and distilled them into 6,454 videos that keep getting recommended there .
The site needs no login, shows a single mid-video frame instead of optimized thumbnails, and stores state locally in the browser.
Andrej Karpathy, OpenAI co-founder and current Anthropic AI researcher, built HackerTube over a weekend using Claude's Opus 5.5 model.

Anthropic.summary:
Hodgkin and Huxley’s approach can be broken down into three steps, and most scientific modeling involves some version of them.
All SBI requires is that you can run the model: put in a set of parameters and get back the kind of data you would expect to see.
Hodgkin and Huxley’s four-particle hypothesis came about because equations involving the fourth power are what you would expect if four separate things all had to happen before a gate could open.

Anthropic.title: Investigating vault particles with Claude
Anthropic.summary:
We began by using Claude Science to search for the vault protein’s relatives across a database of about 15 billion predicted proteins.
We moved the best performers into living E. coli bacteria, where 15 of 24 produced soluble protein.
We took the project on anyway, because Claude could make up for what we didn’t know and rapidly perform analyses that would otherwise have taken us much longer.

Anthropic.title: Extend Claude Code to remote sessions on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with security controls | Amazon Web Services
Anthropic.titleEn: Extend Claude Code to remote sessions on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with security controls | Amazon Web Services
Anthropic.titleKo: 보안 제어를 통해 Claude Code를 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore의 원격 세션으로 확장 | 아마존 웹 서비스
Anthropic.summary:
Amazon Bedrock doesn’t use your content to train models or share it with model providers, and providers can’t access your prompts, completions, or the Amazon Bedrock service logs.
Model calls from remote tasks therefore keep the same security characteristics as Claude Code on your laptop.
Claude Code reviews the result with Claude Opus and can send it back to planning for another attempt, up to three attempts in total.

Anthropic.title: The components of agent memory
Anthropic.summary:
In this post, we share how we’ve come to think about agent memory and walk through several evaluations we’ve used to explore agent memory, including the use of dreaming, and what each component contributes to memory organization.
Sonnet 3.7’s approach was a problem mainly because the game state of Pokémon changes constantly—Sonnet 3.7’s detailed record was continuously going out of date.
By writing down a rule, an agent predicts that the pattern it’s describing will be relevant again.

OpenAI.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra for faster, better performing AI agents at half the price - SiliconANGLE
OpenAI.titleEn: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra for faster, better performing AI agents at half the price - SiliconANGLE
OpenAI.titleKo: OpenAI, 절반 가격으로 더 빠르고 더 나은 성능의 AI 에이전트를 위한 GPT-6.1 Terra 출시 - SiliconANGLE
OpenAI.summary:
On the Terminal-Bench 4.0 test, which measures coding agents on tasks done through a computer’s command-line terminal, it solved 50.3% of all tasks when using maximum reasoning effort, up from 21.5% with GPT-5.6 Terra.
The new model is the successor to GTP-5.6 Terra and is said to cost around 50% less while handling computer use tasks faster and with greater accuracy.
GPT-6.1 Terra understands what’s on screen, takes action across apps, writes naturally, and is a more capable model for your whole workday with the efficiency to take on more of it. pic.twitter.com/8JTN1yonmV OpenAI said the model is available now for all ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex.
summaryLinesEn: On the Terminal-Bench 4.0 test, which measures coding agents on tasks done through a computer’s command-line terminal, it solved 50.3% of all tasks when using maximum reasoning effort, up from 21.5% with GPT-5.6 Terra.
The new model is the successor to GTP-5.6 Terra and is said to cost around 50% less while handling computer use tasks faster and with greater accuracy.

GPT-6.1 Terra understands what’s on screen, takes action across apps, writes naturally, and is a more capable model for your whole workday with the efficiency to take on more of it. pic.twitter.com/8JTN1yonmV OpenAI said the model is available now for all ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex.
summaryLinesKo: 컴퓨터의 명령줄 터미널을 통해 수행되는 작업에 대한 코딩 에이전트를 측정하는 Terminal-Bench 4.0 테스트에서 최대 추론 노력을 사용할 때 모든 작업의 50.3%를 해결했으며 이는 GPT-5.6 Terra의 21.5%에서 증가한 것임
새로운 모델은 GTP-5.6 Terra의 후속 모델로 컴퓨터 사용 작업을 더 빠르고 정확하게 처리하면서 비용은 약 50% 저렴하다고 함

GPT-6.1 Terra는 화면에 표시된 내용을 이해하고, 여러 앱에서 작업을 수행하고, 자연스럽게 글을 쓰며, 더 많은 작업을 수행할 수 있는 효율성을 갖춘 전체 업무 시간에 더 유능한 모델임 · pic.twitter.com/8JTN1yonmV OpenAI는 이제 ChatGPT Work 및 Codex의 모든 ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Enterprise 및 Edu 사용자가 이 모델을 사용할 수 있다고 말함

Databricks.summary:
Read the customer's table in place instead of copying it: With OpenSharing, you can follow changes on the tables your customers share through streaming or change data feed, without tracking what's been processed yourself.
Can I get new data as soon as my customer writes it, instead of waiting for the next file drop?
Sharing gets easier for your customers: Adding you as a recipient is just a grant on a table they already maintain, and audit logs record every time you access their shared data.

Databricks.title: From Delta Sharing to OpenSharing: what changed, what's next | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: From Delta Sharing to OpenSharing: what changed, what's next | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: Delta Sharing에서 OpenSharing으로 · 변경된 사항과 다음 단계 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
By the time Databricks announced OpenSharing in June 2026, Delta Sharing had reached more than 28,000 data recipients, with roughly a third of shares flowing across platforms through open connectors rather than staying inside Databricks-to-Databricks sharing ( Databricks blog ).
When Databricks introduced Delta Sharing at Data + AI Summit 2021, the core problem it addressed was simple to state and hard to solve well: organizations wanted to share live data with partners, customers, and other teams, without exporting files, standing up brittle ETL jobs, or forcing every recipient onto the same platform.
Existing Delta Sharing setups keep working, and you enable the new asset types on a Unity Catalog metastore using the same share, recipient, and grant workflow.

If AI is destined to become a central feature of both cyber offense and defense, the argument goes, businesses and governments will need to be equipped with models that are freely available and cannot be switched off remotely, unlike proprietary models from the likes of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.
At the time, the company said it was the most advanced open-weight offering outside of China.
After further refinement, Mistral now says Le Chonk is the “world’s best” open-weight model for automated coding and cybersecurity.

Sierra AI.title: Sierra inducted into JPMorganChase Hall of Innovation
Sierra AI.titleEn: Sierra inducted into JPMorganChase Hall of Innovation
Sierra AI.summary:
Established in 2011, the Hall of Innovation recognizes privately held technology companies that have made a significant impact at JPMorganChase through their innovation, business value, and close collaboration with the firm’s teams.
Sierra, the leading customer experience AI platform, today announced its induction into JPMorganChase’s Hall of Innovation.
“Agentic AI has the potential to create simpler, more intuitive experiences for customers, but realizing that potential requires getting trust, security and controls right from the start,” said Gill Haus, Chief Information Officer of Chase.

최고의 고객 경험 AI 플랫폼인 Sierra는 오늘 JPMorganChase의 혁신 전당에 입성한다고 발표함
Chase의 최고 정보 책임자(CIO)인 Gill Haus는 “Agentic AI는 고객을 위해 더 간단하고 직관적인 경험을 제공할 수 있는 잠재력을 갖고 있지만, 그 잠재력을 실현하려면 처음부터 신뢰, 보안 및 통제력을 확보해야 함” · 라고 말함

Sierra AI.title: La ambición de nuestros clientes impulsa nuestro crecimiento
Sierra AI.titleEn: La ambición de nuestros clientes impulsa nuestro crecimiento
Sierra AI.summary:
Y, lo que es más importante, nuestro crecimiento se acelera: tardamos seis meses en duplicar el ARR de 100 a 200 millones de dólares, y solo cinco en pasar de 200 a 400 millones.
Este crecimiento responde a varios factores, entre los que se encuentran: La creciente ambición de nuestros clientes : pese a figurar entre las empresas más grandes y más reguladas del mundo, buscan sacar más partido a sus agentes y avanzar más rápido.

Sierra AI.title: L’ambition de nos clients accélère notre croissance
Sierra AI.titleEn: L’ambition de nos clients accélère notre croissance
Sierra AI.summary:

Plusieurs facteurs expliquent cette croissance, notamment : L’ambition croissante de nos clients — bien qu’ils comptent parmi les plus grandes entreprises au monde et les plus soumises à la réglementation, ils veulent aller plus loin et plus vite avec leurs agents.
Cette semaine, nous avons dépassé les 400 millions de dollars de chiffre d’affaires récurrent annuel (ARR), avec une hausse de plus de 150 millions de dollars au seul troisième trimestre.

Sierra AI.title: Redesigning Agent Studio around Ghostwriter
Sierra AI.summary:
Agent Studio now brings related agents into a single project, along with the data and channels they share, so your team can test and release them together.
Ghostwriter is our agent for building agents — an always-on teammate that not only helps you build but also understands how agents are performing, suggests improvements in Slack and Teams, and pushes whatever you approve live.
When the lender adds a new document requirement, Ghostwriter updates what the first agent asks for and how the second one follows up, all in one session.

Ghostwriter는 에이전트 구축을 위한 에이전트임 · 구축을 도울 뿐만 아니라 에이전트의 수행 방식을 이해하고 Slack 및 Teams의 개선 사항을 제안하며 승인한 모든 것을 실시간으로 푸시하는 상시 팀원임

Scale AI.title: Cities Worldwide Build and Scale AI Services With NVIDIA Physical and Agentic AI
Scale AI.titleEn: Cities Worldwide Build and Scale AI Services With NVIDIA Physical and Agentic AI
Scale AI.titleKo: 전 세계 도시에서는 NVIDIA Physical 및 Agentic AI를 사용하여 AI 서비스를 구축하고 확장함
Scale AI.summary:
Cities can extend AI to more services by building on infrastructure already in place and adding capacity.
In Wrocław, Poland , K2K is building shared AI infrastructure using NVIDIA accelerated computing, NVIDIA Cosmos world reasoning models, and NVIDIA Metropolis Blueprint for video search and summarization (VSS) to transform existing camera streams into actionable intelligence for mobility, safety and event response — using the same infrastructure across several city functions.
City teams don’t need a massive infrastructure investment to get started building these AI services: depending on the workload, NVIDIA RTX workstations or a small GPU system may be enough.

ElevenLabs.summary:
The AI voice startup has deployed an inbound sales development representative (SDR) agent that has handled over 3,000 customer leads this year, qualifying over 90% of those potential clients in 32 different languages without any human intervention.
Marvell says the deal will allow the combined company to address a market worth $550 billion, with Chairman and CEO Matt Murphy saying, “AI infrastructure is undergoing a fundamental architectural shift toward optical connectivity, creating an opportunity that comes along once in a generation.”
He says that the efficiency gains ElevenLabs reaps from agentic AI may feel cutting edge today, but “in six months time, you can see even more gains.”

Marvell은 이번 거래를 통해 합병된 회사가 5,500억 달러 규모의 시장에 진출할 수 있게 될 것이라고 말했으며, Matt Murphy 회장 겸 CEO는 "AI 인프라는 광 연결을 향한 근본적인 아키텍처 변화를 겪고 있으며 한 세대에 한 번씩 찾아오는 기회를 창출하고 있습니다"라고 말함

Lovable.title: How we moved our frontend off Firestore and built Lovable Realtime | Lovable
Lovable.titleEn: How we moved our frontend off Firestore and built Lovable Realtime | Lovable
Lovable.titleKo: 프런트엔드를 Firestore에서 이전하고 Lovable Realtime을 구축한 방법 | 사랑스럽
Lovable.summary:
The service handles peaks of over 2 million concurrent subscriptions and delivers around 2.6 billion data and patch frames per month.
We needed the backend to decide what each user received and keep that decision up to date as both the data and their permissions changed.
When a NATS message arrives, the pod dispatches it to every matching subscription instance, which re-evaluates its data projection, deduplicates via xxh3-128 hash, and pushes the deltas to the frontend if the output changed.

각 사용자가 수신한 내용을 결정하고 데이터와 권한이 변경됨에 따라 해당 결정을 최신 상태로 유지하기 위해 백엔드가 필요함
NATS 메시지가 도착하면 포드는 이를 일치하는 모든 구독 인스턴스에 전달함 · 그러면 데이터 프로젝션을 다시 평가하고 xxh3-128 해시를 통해 중복을 제거하며 출력이 변경되면 델타를 프런트엔드에 푸시함

Suno.summary:
It recently filed a lawsuit against Anthropic , claiming $41 million in damages for allegedly training its AI models on the musician's works without permission.
New lawsuits are claiming that Suno has once again committed copyright infringement by using Elvis Presley and Eminem's likeness to create AI-generated songs.
As first reported by Variety , a group that owns the rights to Presley's music and Eight Mile Style, a music publishing company that owns hundreds of Eminem recordings, filed separate lawsuits against Suno.

As first reported by Variety , a group that owns the rights to Presley's music and Eight Mile Style, a music publishing company that owns hundreds of Eminem recordings, filed separate lawsuits against Suno.

Suno.summary:
It can contain up to 16 channels of pitch and timing data, each with up to 120 controller lanes for things like modulation, volume and sustain.
MIDI is the newest of these starting points, and it works differently from the other uploadable assets because a MIDI file contains no sound at all.
But first, let’s begin with explaining what MIDI is, and why it offers such a good starting point to the creation process.

Hugging Face.summary:
Because Liva owns both the collection environment and distribution, it can design products around specific model gaps across domains, industries, languages, modalities, and interaction types.
A few months ago, we added private data to the Open ASR Leaderboard : 11 splits from Appen and DataOceanAI covering scripted and conversational speech from five accents ( blog ).
We’re excited to announce a new collaboration with Liva AI to add even more private data with two new accents: Egyptian 🇪🇬 and Nigerian 🇳🇬.

Hugging Face.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
Hugging Face.titleEn: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
Hugging Face.titleKo: ToyBlocks: 로봇 학습 및 평가를 위한 통제된 세계
Hugging Face.summary:
ToyBlocks scales data generation through generating and executing hundreds of such plans in parallel on a single graphics processing unit (GPU), reaching up to 24 times real-time performance.
During the episode, the agent muses, “I need to figure out whether pick-and-place naturally straightens orientation or if I need to correct it manually… I have 63 calls left, plenty to run a controlled test” (0:06).
Building on our earlier work in open robot learning, including MolmoAct 2 , MolmoBot , and MolmoSpaces , ToyBlocks gives researchers a way to study robotics questions in a deliberately constrained domain.

Building on our earlier work in open robot learning, including MolmoAct 2 , MolmoBot , and MolmoSpaces , ToyBlocks gives researchers a way to study robotics questions in a deliberately constrained domain.

에피소드 중에 에이전트는 "선택 및 배치가 자연스럽게 방향을 곧게 펴는지, 아니면 수동으로 수정해야 하는지 파악해야 함 · 통화가 63개 남았으니 통제된 테스트를 실행하기에 충분합니다."(0:06)라고 생각함
MolmoAct 2, MolmoBot 및 MolmoSpaces를 포함한 개방형 로봇 학습에 대한 이전 작업을 기반으로 ToyBlocks는 연구자에게 의도적으로 제한된 영역에서 로봇 공학 질문을 연구할 수 있는 방법을 제공함

Hugging Face.title: A Closer Look at Phonon TTS. Launching High-Quality On-Device Speech That Tops the Benchmarks.
Hugging Face.titleEn: A Closer Look at Phonon TTS. Launching High-Quality On-Device Speech That Tops the Benchmarks.
Hugging Face.titleKo: 포논 TTS를 자세히 살펴보세요 · 벤치마크를 능가하는 고품질 온디바이스 음성 출시
Hugging Face.summary:
How Phonon did on the Hugging Face Open TTS Leaderboard Two weeks ago, we opened up Phonon, our small text-to-speech model that runs on your own device.
It needs no server and no network, and what you type stays with you.
On intelligibility, Phonon ranks first in German and Spanish , and in the top three in every language we evaluated, next to models up to 100 times its size.

Hugging Face.title: Dharma Field Extractor: Any Document In, Structured Fields in JSON Out
Hugging Face.titleEn: Dharma Field Extractor: Any Document In, Structured Fields in JSON Out
Hugging Face.titleKo: Dharma 필드 추출기 · 모든 문서 입력, JSON 출력의 구조화된 필드
Hugging Face.summary:
The full benchmark covers 546 documents across three request scenarios, for 1,638 total cases: extracting every field with no schema, a partial schema naming only real fields, and a schema that also includes deliberately nonexistent fields.
A 2-billion-parameter model that extracts exactly the fields you ask for, from any document type, outperforming every frontier LLM we tested, at a fraction of the cost.
Ours isn't billed per token: the model runs self-hosted, so the figure is GPU time on a single L40S at $2.24 per hour.

Ours isn't billed per token: the model runs self-hosted, so the figure is GPU time on a single L40S at $2.24 per hour.

Hugging Face.title: CWE-bench v2: More coverage, quality, and transparency
Hugging Face.titleEn: CWE-bench v2: More coverage, quality, and transparency
Hugging Face.titleKo: CWE-bench v2: 더 많은 적용 범위, 품질 및 투명성
Hugging Face.summary:
In our continued pursuit to push the horizon at Collinear AI , CWE-bench v2 opens up a public set of 100 tasks that anyone can run and evaluate their models on.
On cost, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (1017), Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon form the Pareto frontier: DeepSeek reaches 57.0% pass@1 at $0.04 per rollout, Opus adds ten points at $1.83, and Gemini edges ahead at $3.92.
Harbor can therefore run the whole benchmark straight from the Hugging Face repo, without cloning anything yourself: -k 4 runs 4 attempts per task, and the reported score is the mean reward over all 400 trials.

Harbor can therefore run the whole benchmark straight from the Hugging Face repo, without cloning anything yourself: -k 4 runs 4 attempts per task, and the reported score is the mean reward over all 400 trials.

Hugging Face.title: Transformers Model Integration Contracts
Hugging Face.summary:
108.6 billion parameters become 44.7 million.
Transformers supports over 750 model types, and its test suite is big: 88,000+ CPU tests on main, plus 200,000+ GPU tests in a daily run.
A Model Integration Contract (MIC) has three parts: a fixture : the shrunk model described above, published once and pinned a usage path : a runnable Markdown example of something people do with the model, such as generating text or running a training step baselines : the outputs recorded when running that example, reviewed by a human The contract holds if running the usage path on the fixture still produces the baselines.

Abridge.summary:
Conditions due for follow-up are in view before the visit starts, orders are staged before the patient leaves, and inpatient notes start from what the chart already holds.
This month, Visit Topics, In-Visit Orders, and Patient Visit Summary Editing with the Abridge Assistant help transform how clinicians prepare for a visit, capture orders throughout the conversation, and send patients home with a summary more easily tailored to them.
Much of the work that makes a visit or a hospital stay take longer than it should is reconstruction: keeping track of which conditions still need follow-up, entering orders after the patient has left, assembling an admission note from across the chart.

Deloitte estimated that generative AI could lift front-office productivity at the world’s largest investment banks by 27% to 35% by 2026, adding roughly $3.5 million in additional revenue per front-office employee.

Writer.title: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report
Writer.titleEn: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report
Writer.titleKo: 2025년 엔터프라이즈 AI 채택 보고서의 주요 결과
Writer.summary:
For our 2025 report, Generative AI adoption in the enterprise, we surveyed a diverse group of 1,600 knowledge workers actively using AI in the workplace — including 800 C-suite executives and 800 employees across the US.
Despite clear benefits, enterprise leaders report division and power struggles from AI adoption While executives are highly optimistic about the future business impact of AI, 42% say the process of adopting generative AI is tearing their company apart.
Enterprises without a formal AI strategy report only 37% success in AI adoption, compared to 80% for those with a strategy.
summaryLinesEn: For our 2025 report, Generative AI adoption in the enterprise, we surveyed a diverse group of 1,600 knowledge workers actively using AI in the workplace — including 800 C-suite executives and 800 employees across the US.

Despite clear benefits, enterprise leaders report division and power struggles from AI adoption While executives are highly optimistic about the future business impact of AI, 42% say the process of adopting generative AI is tearing their company apart.
Enterprises without a formal AI strategy report only 37% success in AI adoption, compared to 80% for those with a strategy.
summaryLinesKo: 2025년 보고서인 기업의 생성적 AI 도입을 위해 우리는 미국 전역의 최고 경영진 800명과 직원 800명을 포함하여 직장에서 AI를 적극적으로 사용하는 1,600명의 지식 근로자로 구성된 다양한 그룹을 대상으로 설문조사를 실시함
분명한 이점에도 불구하고 기업 리더들은 AI 도입으로 인한 분열과 권력 투쟁을 보고함 · 경영진은 AI가 미래 비즈니스에 미칠 영향에 대해 매우 낙관적인 반면, 42%는 생성 AI 도입 과정이 회사를 분열시키고 있다고 말함
공식적인 AI 전략이 없는 기업은 AI 도입 성공률이 37%에 불과한 반면 전략이 있는 기업은 80%에 불과함

Writer.summary:
Today, 75% of knowledge workers use GenAI at work, but only about a third of organizations have formal AI governance in place For CIOs, this creates a familiar and uncomfortable reality: AI enthusiasm is accelerating faster than enterprise readiness.
Our newly introduced agent supervision suite delivers the governance foundation the report calls for — providing centralized visibility into usage and cost, global guardrails for sensitive data, runtime permissions and approvals, and deep integrations with your existing observability and security platforms.
And they need a model where IT can maintain oversight even as business teams accelerate adoption.

Writer.titleEn: Five Rules for Using AI Without Creating Work Slop
Writer.titleKo: 업무 슬롭을 만들지 않고 AI를 사용하기 위한 5가지 규칙
Writer.summary:
With AI tools, I — a person who can’t draw a stick figure — can whip up illustrations, videos, slide decks, and some theme music to go with them at the push of a button.
Use of the AI in the workplace is growing rapidly , but simply making loads more content won’t help your team increase productivity or make an impact if it’s all kind of … blah.
They let you refine your instructions iteratively, add variables for repeatability, easily share improvements with colleagues, and build something that gets better every time you use it.

Meta AI.title: On Facebook and Instagram, Political Ads Are Increasingly Critical of Data Centers
Meta AI.titleEn: On Facebook and Instagram, Political Ads Are Increasingly Critical of Data Centers
Meta AI.titleKo: Facebook과 Instagram에서 정치 광고는 데이터 센터에 점점 더 중요해지고 있음
Meta AI.summary:
Over a period of 90 days from Jul. 27 to Oct. 24, advertisers on Facebook and Instagram spent almost $12 million on ads that mention data centers in the context of social issues, elections or politics .
The remaining 39% of recent spending has been for ads that support specific candidates.
Since late July, advertisers spent more than $1 million on political ads mentioning data centers that targeted Facebook and Instagram users in each of three states – Ohio, Wisconsin and Texas.

summaryLinesKo: 7월 27일부터 10월 24일까지 90일 동안 Facebook과 Instagram의 광고주들은 사회 문제, 선거 또는 정치와 관련된 데이터 센터를 언급하는 광고에 거의 1,200만 달러를 지출함
최근 지출의 나머지 39%는 특정 후보자를 지지하는 광고에 사용됨

Meta AI.summary:
His desire to open-source this project was partly why he left Meta and decided to go it alone.
The former director at Meta Superintelligence Labs has launched Ndoc , a startup he’s pitching as an AI-native replacement for Microsoft Office suite or Google Workspace.
At a big company like Meta, getting everyone to agree on an open source format would undoubtedly require the input of “hundreds of people and opinions on how the format should look.”
